title: L31 — THE LEVERAGE ISN'T THE RISK
voice: You've been told leverage is what kills accounts. So you keep yours low and feel safe. Meanwhile the professionals run far more leverage than you — and they're still here. Something in that story doesn't add up.

Leverage is not risk. Leverage is how much room the broker gives you to hold a position. Risk is something else entirely: how much you lose if price hits your stop. That's your size, times the distance. Leverage doesn't appear in that equation at all.

So a professional can run enormous leverage with a tiny position and risk almost nothing. And a beginner can run low leverage with a position so big that a normal move takes a huge bite. Same account, opposite danger. The number everyone stares at is the one that matters least.

Here's why the confusion is expensive. Focusing on leverage makes you feel safe while you size up. You lower the leverage, you feel responsible, then you put on a position that's far too big for your stop distance — and you never see it coming, because the number you were watching looked fine.

So stop asking how much leverage you're using. Ask: if this stop gets hit, what does it cost me? That's the only number that decides whether you survive. Leverage is the room you're allowed. Risk is what you actually put on the table.

Comment "LINE" for the checklist on what actually kills accounts. Professionals run more leverage than you — and they're still here.

Leverage isn't risk. Leverage is the room the broker gives you. Risk is size times the distance to your stop — leverage isn't in that equation at all. Lowering it makes you feel safe while you size up, and that's exactly when it breaks.

THE LINE — if this stop gets hit, what does it cost you? That's the only number.

_rules.doctrine: levier vs risque — LA VEINE PROUVÉE (l'outlier 270 vues portait ce sujet en framing contre-intuitif). Angle : le levier est la place autorisée, le risque est taille × distance. Factuel, mécanique. Garde-fou : la perte = tranche du compte, JAMAIS de dette au-delà du dépôt.
_rules.caption_structure: LIGNE 1 = CTA D'ABORD, puis l'accroche. Mot-clé visible immédiatement.
_rules.emotion_frame0: CURIOSITÉ + CHOC — deux paires absurdement disproportionnées dès la frame 0, l'anomalie happe l'œil.
_rules.fusil: les deux paires disproportionnées (S1), le levier hors de l'équation (S2), pro vs débutant (S3), le faux sentiment de sécurité (S4), résolu : c'est le petit levier qui explose (S5).
_rules.fin_actionnable: la question-règle 'if this stop gets hit, what does it cost?' + l'équation taille × distance — mémorisable, à enregistrer.
_rules.interdits: aucun chiffre; gris = perte (M-couleur), pas de rouge; pas de brun; bas du cadre vide; pas de nom de broker.
